column1: # each change: its files, then the jobs it needs (none when empty), separated by spaces
# the archsim-check action builds the CLI from its modules and the Gradle build
# a module's tests, test fixtures, README and build file run what its sources do
# the API and app tests read the fixtures, in the Java job
# the table repr reads, one of the model's main resources
# the Java harness's report tests compare the accuracy page's copy with docs/validation/
# the Java engine's tests check the web fixtures; the Java model's tests read the starter
# the end-to-end launcher starts the worker, whose command line the Java tests check
# the kept results, which the Java harness's tests reduce again
# the stacks and their load, which the Java harness's tests read
# the tooling's own tests, which the Java build runs; the commit check always runs
# the frozen engine's golden files and simulation baselines, which the Java tests read
# the Java harness's report tests read them too
# stage 4's parity page, which the Java harness writes and checks, and its runs
# the engines' speed, which only the parity page's test reads, and the earlier measurements,
# the Java engine generates the page, and its tests check it
# the Java harness's tests read its cpuset loop
# files from several parts run what any of them needs
